actions.command: cd /app && (command -v qemu-system-x86_64 || command -v qemu-system-i386 || command -v qemu-kvm || true) && ls -l /app/alpine.iso /app/alpine-disk.qcow2 && (nohup qemu-system-x86_64 -m 512 -nographic -serial telnet:127.0.0.1:6665,server,nowait -drive file=/app/alpine.iso,media=cdrom,readonly=on -drive file=/app/alpine-disk.qcow2,if=virtio,format=qcow2 >/tmp/alpine-qemu.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/alpine-qemu.pid) && sleep 3 && (cat /tmp/alpine-qemu.log || true)
